reviewSupplement.answer: B under the broad definition of a natural orbiting body: moons orbit planets, and planets/comets orbit the Sun. Some school conventions reserve satellite for objects orbiting planets; clarify that convention.
reviewSupplement.note: Satellite terminology varies: source includes planets and comets as natural satellites of the Sun. Teacher must state the definition before assessing.

reviewSupplement.answer: No option gives the main explanation: sunlight is concentrated over a smaller area at high solar elevation. A shorter atmospheric path is secondary, not the Sun–Earth surface-distance effect suggested by A.
reviewSupplement.note: No option clearly states the principal cause of equatorial heating: solar incidence angle and energy per unit area. Do not automatically score A as a sufficient explanation.
